what_it_claims: verdict PUSH_PATH_OK plus whether the planned ref name is already taken
defect: `ls_remote()` keys its map by the FULLY QUALIFIED ref name it gets back, but the free-name check looks up the string the caller typed. The documented and commanded call form is the bare name (`review/B-...`), so the lookup never hits and every ref reads as free.

control_authority_bare_name.why_this_is_decisive: the authority branch is by definition occupied; reading it as free cannot be an artifact of my own case

blast_radius_honest_limits: it does not let a lane clobber history: a non-fast-forward push is still refused by git without --force, and my own second push (c4a1b339 -> 003886ca) was a fast-forward of my own branch

what it does break is the promise the tool's header makes -- report a taken name so the lane publishes a NEW revision instead of assuming the name is unused -- and any patrol that reads target_ref_free as evidence
I did not edit the instrument: per R14 its owner fixes it, this file only carries the readings
suggested_fix_by_owner: look the target up as `"refs/heads/" + ref` (or normalise both sides), and add an arm that asks for a ref known to be occupied -- the control above is that arm and costs one line
